phaseBoundary: Classification only. Multiple parents do not imply disjointness unless declared. No executable effects, triggers, costs, choices, targets, or state transitions are encoded.

taxa.label: Entity
taxa.definitionBoundary: A persistent game-world, information, component, or spatial object.

taxa.label: Process type
taxa.definitionBoundary: A temporally extended game occurrence; this layer names process types but does not encode executable procedures.

taxa.label: State or status
taxa.definitionBoundary: A condition that may hold for an entity or information object; transitions are not encoded here.

taxa.label: Contextual role
taxa.definitionBoundary: A role held by an entity in a context rather than an intrinsic entity class.

taxa.label: Rule or mode concept
taxa.definitionBoundary: A game-mode or cross-cutting rule concept, not a physical component.

taxa.label: Value kind
taxa.definitionBoundary: An enumerated or quantitative value used by static game structure.

taxa.label: Printed symbol kind
taxa.definitionBoundary: A printed icon/glyph result. It may denote another taxon but is not identical to its artwork.

taxa.label: Named source identity kind
taxa.definitionBoundary: A source-local named component, face, label, or structured key; exact name equality alone does not establish gameplay equivalence.

taxa.label: Semantic-model scaffold
taxa.definitionBoundary: Static ontology scaffolding for later timing, decision, visibility, zone, and lifecycle semantics; no effect instances are encoded.

taxa.label: Agent
taxa.definitionBoundary: An entity capable of acting, being targeted, or occupying game space.

taxa.label: Participant agent
taxa.definitionBoundary: Human participant or their controlled Character.

taxa.label: Player
taxa.definitionBoundary: Human participant controlling a Character.

taxa.label: Character
taxa.definitionBoundary: In-game Character controlled by a Player.

taxa.label: Robot
taxa.definitionBoundary: Robot model/entity activated under Robot rules.

taxa.label: Intruder
taxa.definitionBoundary: Primeblood Intruder entity; Characters are not Intruders.

taxa.label: Queen
taxa.definitionBoundary: Queen Intruder type.

taxa.label: Drone
taxa.definitionBoundary: Drone Intruder type.

taxa.label: Adult
taxa.definitionBoundary: Adult Intruder type.

taxa.label: Larva
taxa.definitionBoundary: Larva Intruder type.

taxa.label: Spatial entity
taxa.definitionBoundary: A map, Facility, location, slot, or structural connector.

taxa.label: Map
taxa.definitionBoundary: The spatial play surface showing the Facility.

taxa.label: Facility
taxa.definitionBoundary: The base-game Facility divided into Sections A, B, and C.

taxa.label: Section
taxa.definitionBoundary: One of the three Facility Sections.

taxa.label: Section A
taxa.definitionBoundary: The enumerated printed Section A identity, not a subclass inferred from name alone.

taxa.label: Section B
taxa.definitionBoundary: The enumerated printed Section B identity, not a subclass inferred from name alone.

taxa.label: Section C
taxa.definitionBoundary: The enumerated printed Section C identity, not a subclass inferred from name alone.

taxa.label: Location
taxa.definitionBoundary: A location capable of containing game entities.

taxa.label: Room
taxa.definitionBoundary: A Facility Room. Characters may occupy Rooms, not Corridors.

taxa.label: Room slot
taxa.definitionBoundary: A Facility-map slot that may be empty/Undiscovered or hold a placed Room.

taxa.label: Corridor
taxa.definitionBoundary: A connector between two adjacent Room/Room-slot endpoints; Intruders but not Characters may occupy it.

taxa.label: Door
taxa.definitionBoundary: A Door at a Corridor end against a Room.

taxa.label: Nest Room identity
taxa.definitionBoundary: The named Nest Room identity, not a general Room subclass.

taxa.label: Hibernatorium Room identity
taxa.definitionBoundary: The named Hibernatorium Room identity, not a general Room subclass.

taxa.label: Landing Zone Room identity
taxa.definitionBoundary: The named Landing Zone Room identity, not a general Room subclass.

taxa.label: Escape Shuttle Room identity
taxa.definitionBoundary: The named Escape Shuttle Room identity, not a general Room subclass.

taxa.label: Reactor Room identity
taxa.definitionBoundary: The named Reactor Room identity, not a general Room subclass.

taxa.label: Component copy/runtime entity
taxa.definitionBoundary: A physical component copy or runtime entity in one game, distinct from its definition and source occurrence.

taxa.label: Component set or supply
taxa.definitionBoundary: A deck, pile, pool, insert, or finite set from which component copies are supplied.

taxa.label: Card
taxa.definitionBoundary: A printed card component.

taxa.label: Action card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Character-specific Action card, distinct from a Basic Action.

taxa.label: Contamination card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Contamination card sharing a back with Action cards but forming a separate deck.

taxa.label: Event card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Event card resolved in Event Phase.

taxa.label: Exploration card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Exploration card used in Exploration Sequence.

taxa.label: Intruder Attack card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Card containing effects by Intruder type.

taxa.label: Queen Health card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Card in the Queen Health deck.

taxa.label: Serious Wound card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Persistent Serious Wound card.

taxa.label: Robot card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Card determining Robot rules/identity.

taxa.label: Mission Task card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Card carrying a Mission Task.

taxa.label: Objective card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Card carrying an Objective.

taxa.label: Solo/Coop Objective card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Objective card scoped to Solo/Coop rules.

taxa.label: Character Draft card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Card used in Character Draft.

taxa.label: Help card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Numbered Player Help card/reference component.

taxa.label: Information object
taxa.definitionBoundary: Rules-bearing information that can be printed on a component.

taxa.label: Component definition
taxa.definitionBoundary: Rules-bearing definition shared by one or more component copies; distinct from a source occurrence and runtime copy.

taxa.label: Room definition
taxa.definitionBoundary: Definition of a named Room effect/metadata entry.

taxa.label: Card-face definition
taxa.definitionBoundary: Definition of one scoped card face/version.

taxa.label: Component-set definition
taxa.definitionBoundary: Definition/inventory of a deck, pile, pool, or component set.

taxa.label: Objective
taxa.definitionBoundary: Endgame condition retained by a player.

taxa.label: Private Objective
taxa.definitionBoundary: Private Objective information type.

taxa.label: Mission Objective
taxa.definitionBoundary: Mission Objective information type.

taxa.label: Mission Task
taxa.definitionBoundary: Mission Task referenced by Mission Objectives; not itself an Objective subtype.

taxa.label: Item card
taxa.definitionBoundary: Card representing an Item.

taxa.label: Regular Item
taxa.definitionBoundary: Vertical Backpack Item card without Armor keyword.

taxa.label: Heavy Item
taxa.definitionBoundary: Horizontal Item card held in a Hand slot.

taxa.label: Armor Item
taxa.definitionBoundary: Item card carrying the Armor keyword and worn on the Health track.

taxa.label: Character Item
taxa.definitionBoundary: Per-character starting equipment source family.

taxa.label: Support Equipment
taxa.definitionBoundary: Support Equipment source family.

taxa.label: Weapon
taxa.definitionBoundary: Weapon Item; functional category that may overlap source families.

taxa.label: Ranged Weapon
taxa.definitionBoundary: Weapon usable for Shoot/Burst when otherwise legal.

taxa.label: Melee Weapon
taxa.definitionBoundary: Melee Weapon functional category.

taxa.label: Token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Physical token component.

taxa.label: Data token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Data token.

taxa.label: Egg token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Egg token.

taxa.label: Tactical Gear token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Consumable Ammo, Grenade, Oxygen, or Medpack token.

taxa.label: Ammo Tactical Gear token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Ammo token.

taxa.label: Grenade Tactical Gear token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Grenade token.

taxa.label: Oxygen Tactical Gear token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Oxygen token.

taxa.label: Medpack Tactical Gear token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Medpack token.

taxa.label: Round marker
taxa.definitionBoundary: Round marker on Round track.

taxa.label: Starting Player token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Token identifying the Starting Player.

taxa.label: Suffocating token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Suffocating status token.

taxa.label: Anti-Aircraft token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Anti-Aircraft status/order token.

taxa.label: Lander token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Lander token on the Round track/map.

taxa.label: Autodestruction token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Autodestruction token on the Round track.

taxa.label: Marker
taxa.definitionBoundary: Marker component representing Hits, Fire, Malfunction, Noise, or similar state.

taxa.label: Universal marker
taxa.definitionBoundary: General-purpose Universal marker.

taxa.label: Fire marker
taxa.definitionBoundary: Fire marker.

taxa.label: Malfunction marker
taxa.definitionBoundary: Malfunction marker.

taxa.label: Noise marker
taxa.definitionBoundary: Noise marker placed in Corridors.

taxa.label: Secure token
taxa.definitionBoundary: Secure token placed in Rooms.

taxa.label: Component slot
taxa.definitionBoundary: A printed slot that may hold a compatible component.

taxa.label: Tactical Gear Slot
taxa.definitionBoundary: Slot accepting Tactical Gear tokens by type or Any.

taxa.label: Hand Slot
taxa.definitionBoundary: Character Hand slot for Heavy Items.

taxa.label: Storage area
taxa.definitionBoundary: Board/card-holder area that stores components or cards.

taxa.label: Backpack
taxa.definitionBoundary: Secret unlimited storage for Regular Items.

taxa.label: Tactical Belt
taxa.definitionBoundary: Four Any Tactical Gear slots on a Character board.

taxa.label: Temporal structure
taxa.definitionBoundary: Round/Phase/Turn structural process.

taxa.label: Round
taxa.definitionBoundary: One ordered Player, Intruder, Event, and Cleanup phase cycle.

taxa.label: Phase
taxa.definitionBoundary: Named Round phase.

taxa.label: Player Phase
taxa.definitionBoundary: Player Phase.

taxa.label: Intruder Phase
taxa.definitionBoundary: Intruder Phase.

taxa.label: Event Phase
taxa.definitionBoundary: Event Phase.

taxa.label: Cleanup Phase
taxa.definitionBoundary: Cleanup Phase.

taxa.label: Turn
taxa.definitionBoundary: Player Turn during Player Phase.

taxa.label: Action
taxa.definitionBoundary: Action process performed under Action timing/cost rules.

taxa.label: Basic Action
taxa.definitionBoundary: Always-available option distinct from an Action card.

taxa.label: Card/effect process
taxa.definitionBoundary: Process invoked by printed card/effect text; it is not automatically an Action.

taxa.label: Reaction
taxa.definitionBoundary: Reaction process; the rulebook explicitly says it is not an Action.

taxa.label: Command
taxa.definitionBoundary: Ordering process granted by an effect; the commanded Character may perform an Action.

taxa.label: Pass
taxa.definitionBoundary: Pass Action ending participation in later Player-Phase rotations.

taxa.label: Move
taxa.definitionBoundary: Movement Action.

taxa.label: Make a Move
taxa.definitionBoundary: Printed Make a Move Action label.

taxa.label: Moving Cautiously
taxa.definitionBoundary: Cautious movement variant.

taxa.label: Attack
taxa.definitionBoundary: Generic attack process family; not every Attack is a player Action.

taxa.label: Opportunity Attack
taxa.definitionBoundary: Attack triggered during Movement before relocation; not a selected Action.

taxa.label: Shoot
taxa.definitionBoundary: Shoot is both a player Action type and an attack process.

taxa.label: Burst
taxa.definitionBoundary: Burst is both a player Action type and an attack process.

taxa.label: Melee Attack
taxa.definitionBoundary: Melee Attack is both a player Action type and an attack process.

taxa.label: Repel
taxa.definitionBoundary: Movement operation produced by a source effect, not a universal Basic Action.

taxa.label: Search
taxa.definitionBoundary: Search is an Action-card effect resolved through Play an Action card, not a universal Basic Action.

taxa.label: Use the Room
taxa.definitionBoundary: Use Room Action.

taxa.label: Trade
taxa.definitionBoundary: Trade Action.

taxa.label: Use Any Tactical Gear Action
taxa.definitionBoundary: Tactical Gear Action.

taxa.label: Resolution sequence
taxa.definitionBoundary: Named ordered resolution sequence; individual steps are deferred to semantic modeling.

taxa.label: Movement Sequence
taxa.definitionBoundary: Movement Sequence.

taxa.label: Exploration Sequence
taxa.definitionBoundary: Exploration Sequence.

taxa.label: Noise Roll
taxa.definitionBoundary: Noise Roll resolution.

taxa.label: Resolution operation
taxa.definitionBoundary: Primitive operation label used by rules; its executable semantics are deferred.

taxa.label: Hit
taxa.definitionBoundary: Deal/record a Hit.

taxa.label: Draw
taxa.definitionBoundary: Draw a card/token/component from a source.

taxa.label: Discard
taxa.definitionBoundary: Move a component to a discard destination or source-defined discard location.

taxa.label: Procedure
taxa.definitionBoundary: Named rules procedure.

taxa.label: Infection Procedure
taxa.definitionBoundary: Infection Procedure.

taxa.label: Eclosion Procedure
taxa.definitionBoundary: Eclosion Procedure.

taxa.label: Autodestruction Procedure
taxa.definitionBoundary: Autodestruction Procedure.

taxa.label: End of the Game
taxa.definitionBoundary: End-of-game sequence.

taxa.label: Escape
taxa.definitionBoundary: Escape process/status transition.

taxa.label: Hibernate
taxa.definitionBoundary: Hibernation process/status transition.

taxa.label: Health state
taxa.definitionBoundary: Character health/status condition.

taxa.label: Health Point value
taxa.definitionBoundary: Quantified Character Health point.

taxa.label: Healthy
taxa.definitionBoundary: Healthy Character state.

taxa.label: Injured
taxa.definitionBoundary: Injured Character state.

taxa.label: Heavily Injured
taxa.definitionBoundary: Heavily Injured Character state.

taxa.label: Infection-related state
taxa.definitionBoundary: Infection/Contamination state family.

taxa.label: Infected
taxa.definitionBoundary: Infected state determined by scanning.

taxa.label: Contamination
taxa.definitionBoundary: Contamination condition/concept, distinct from a Contamination card component.

taxa.label: Discovery state
taxa.definitionBoundary: Discovered/Undiscovered spatial state.

taxa.label: Discovered
taxa.definitionBoundary: Discovered state.

taxa.label: Undiscovered
taxa.definitionBoundary: Undiscovered state.

taxa.label: Door state
taxa.definitionBoundary: Opened/Closed/Destroyed Door state.

taxa.label: Opened
taxa.definitionBoundary: Opened state; typically applied to Doors.

taxa.label: Closed
taxa.definitionBoundary: Closed state; typically applied to Doors.

taxa.label: Destroyed
taxa.definitionBoundary: Destroyed state applicable to Doors, Rooms, Nest, or Facility where sources say so.

taxa.label: Corridor status
taxa.definitionBoundary: Corridor Empty/Unexplored/Reinforced status dimension.

taxa.label: Reinforced Corridor
taxa.definitionBoundary: Corridor reinforced status/value 0.

taxa.label: Empty Corridor
taxa.definitionBoundary: Corridor containing no Intruders; a Corridor with a Noise marker is still Empty.

taxa.label: Unexplored Corridor
taxa.definitionBoundary: Corridor connected with only one placed Room.

taxa.label: Objective status
taxa.definitionBoundary: Objective fulfillment state.

taxa.label: Fulfilled
taxa.definitionBoundary: Objective/Mission Task fulfilled state.

taxa.label: Participation/endgame state
taxa.definitionBoundary: Character participation/survival state family.

taxa.label: Survivor
taxa.definitionBoundary: Character satisfies the Objective Help definition of Survivor.

taxa.label: Escaped
taxa.definitionBoundary: Character has Escaped according to Objective Help/endgame rules.

taxa.label: Hibernated
taxa.definitionBoundary: Character has successfully Hibernated.

taxa.label: Combat status
taxa.definitionBoundary: Character combat condition derived from sharing a Room with an Intruder.

taxa.label: Not In Combat
taxa.definitionBoundary: Restriction/status meaning the Character is not in a Room with an Intruder.

taxa.label: Activation state
taxa.definitionBoundary: Active/Inactive state for Life Support or Hibernatorium components.

taxa.label: Active
taxa.definitionBoundary: Active face/state.

taxa.label: Inactive
taxa.definitionBoundary: Inactive face/state.

taxa.label: Starting Player
taxa.definitionBoundary: Player holding the Starting Player token.

taxa.label: Character role/identity
taxa.definitionBoundary: Named Character role to which Action cards/decks and Character Items may belong.

taxa.label: Turn Order
taxa.definitionBoundary: Clockwise ordering beginning at Starting Player.

taxa.label: Corridor orientation value
taxa.definitionBoundary: E–W, NE–SW, or NW–SE printed Corridor orientation.

taxa.label: Resource value
taxa.definitionBoundary: Quantified resource such as Oxygen or Character Health.

taxa.label: Oxygen value
taxa.definitionBoundary: Character Oxygen counter/resource value.

taxa.label: Game mode
taxa.definitionBoundary: Rule-set mode or variant.

taxa.label: Deadly Mode
taxa.definitionBoundary: Deadly Mode variant.

taxa.label: Solo and Coop Rules
taxa.definitionBoundary: Solo/Coop rules mode.

taxa.label: Cross-cutting rule constraint
taxa.definitionBoundary: Rule constraint applied across components/effects.

taxa.label: Component Limits
taxa.definitionBoundary: Finite physical component limits.

taxa.label: Nightmare Rule
taxa.definitionBoundary: Nightmare Rule.

taxa.label: Local Effects
taxa.definitionBoundary: Default local-target rule.

taxa.label: Interplay
taxa.definitionBoundary: Consent/direct-use interaction rule.

taxa.label: Die-result symbol
taxa.definitionBoundary: Printed Shoot/Burst/Noise die result identifier.

taxa.label: Item Icon
taxa.definitionBoundary: Red/Yellow/Green Item search icon.

taxa.label: Room-feature symbol
taxa.definitionBoundary: Room feature such as Computer.

taxa.label: Component-reference symbol
taxa.definitionBoundary: Printed icon denoting a component/token/slot.

taxa.label: Entity-reference symbol
taxa.definitionBoundary: Printed icon denoting Character, Robot, or Intruder.

taxa.label: State-reference symbol
taxa.definitionBoundary: Printed icon denoting a state/restriction.

taxa.label: Orientation symbol
taxa.definitionBoundary: Printed Corridor orientation icon.

taxa.label: Metadata symbol
taxa.definitionBoundary: Printed metadata symbol such as Number of Characters.

taxa.label: Zone
taxa.definitionBoundary: Named storage/location zone for components; zone transitions are deferred.

taxa.label: Deck
taxa.definitionBoundary: Deck static zone class.

taxa.label: Discard pile
taxa.definitionBoundary: Discard pile static zone class.

taxa.label: Hand
taxa.definitionBoundary: Hand static zone class.

taxa.label: Backpack zone
taxa.definitionBoundary: Backpack zone static zone class.

taxa.label: Character board zone
taxa.definitionBoundary: Character board zone static zone class.

taxa.label: Removed-from-game zone
taxa.definitionBoundary: Removed-from-game zone static zone class.

taxa.label: Intruder bag
taxa.definitionBoundary: Intruder bag static zone class.

taxa.label: Token pile
taxa.definitionBoundary: Token pile static zone class.

taxa.label: Timing window
taxa.definitionBoundary: Named point/interval in Round, Phase, Turn, Action, or Procedure; specific effect timing is deferred.

taxa.label: Decision
taxa.definitionBoundary: Actor-owned choice; specific options and legality are deferred.

taxa.label: Audience scope
taxa.definitionBoundary: Public/private/temporary visibility category; specific information policies are deferred.

taxa.label: Lifecycle transition
taxa.definitionBoundary: Transition between states/zones; trigger and procedure semantics are deferred.

taxa.label: Finite supply pool
taxa.definitionBoundary: Physical finite supply/pile/deck limiting component availability.

taxa.label: Named Room identity
taxa.definitionBoundary: Exact-string Room title/source identity.

taxa.label: Named card/reference face identity
taxa.definitionBoundary: Exact-string named card/reference face identity.

taxa.label: Named game-term/help label identity
taxa.definitionBoundary: Exact-string game-term/help heading that is not necessarily a component identity.

taxa.label: Secondary structured key identity
taxa.definitionBoundary: BGA/TTS source-local technical object key.

taxa.label: Source occurrence
taxa.definitionBoundary: One exact textual, visual, or structured occurrence in one source tuple.

taxa.label: Help-sheet entry occurrence
taxa.definitionBoundary: One exact Room/Objective/Intruder Help entry occurrence.

taxa.label: Printed icon occurrence
taxa.definitionBoundary: One source-local functional icon occurrence on a face/help entry.
